summary: Verified bug fix: 'Belum diisi' removed from summary-region-filter dropdown. Backend /api/admin/stats and frontend AdminRegistrationSummary both validated. 9/9 backend pytest passes; frontend Playwright confirms exact 7-option dropdown (Keseluruhan Wilayah + 6 Jakarta regions), region-scoped stats render correctly, chart renders per region, and no mobile overflow at 390px viewport. Sum of per-region participants = 50, matching seed. Seed data mdj-student-sample-2026 preserved.
critical_code_review_comments: Defensive frontend filter (item !== 'Belum diisi') is redundant now that backend excludes it in available_regions; consider removing frontend filter later to keep single source of truth, but harmless.
seed_data_creation: None (existing seed of 50 students preserved; region distribution 8/9/8/8/9/8 sums to 50)
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_admin_summary_regions.py can serve as regression for available_regions filter and by-region stats. Login demo autofill button 'Admin / PIC' auto-submits and redirects to /admin (Ringkasan) directly.
